name: +1 Speed Rock Escape
desc:
Welcome to +1 Speed Rock Escape!

💥 OUTRUN THE GIANT ROCK!

Dodge the giant rock's sudden charges, time your moves perfectly, and make it to the end before getting crushed. Every second counts when the giant rock is after you.

⚡Get +1 Speed per step, and more as you level up!
💰 Buy pets with wins to get faster!
🛠️ Use your wins to upgrade once you reach the end!
👍 LIKE the game!
